# golden_wire_removed.txt — wire keys deliberately deleted from the golden
# contract at a breaking release (tagcheck rule golden-removed).
#
# Format: <repo-relative package dir><TAB><struct name><TAB><Go field name><TAB><justification>
# Blank lines and # comments are ignored.
#
# A listed key suppresses the golden-missing violation its deletion would
# otherwise produce, and the generator (tools/tagcheck/cmd/taggolden) omits
# it when regenerating golden_wire_fields.txt from the immutable history,
# so the regenerated file stays byte-stable.
#
# Breaking-change PRs only, with explicit maintainer review. The guard
# rejects a stale entry instead of letting it rot: tagcheck fails an entry
# that names a struct which is not registered in golden_wire_structs.txt
# or a Go field that still exists in the tree, and the generator fails an
# entry that matches no field of the struct at its base revision (nothing
# to bless).
#
config	Service	Adapter	feat!: adapter selection moved to container.Provide; *_ADAPTER env removed, Adapter field deleted from options-only Service envelope
config	ServiceConfig	Adapter	feat!: adapter selection moved to container.Provide; *_ADAPTER env removed, Adapter field deleted from options-only Service envelope
